offering_description.value: TransUnion gives consumers free online access to credit reports, credit scores, monitoring and alerts. It also shows consumers personalized credit card offers supplied by Bankrate, which pays TransUnion when consumers interact with the offers.

quotes.quote: Free TransUnion® credit report & score. Free credit monitoring, alerts and personalized offers. All free, all in 1. No credit card required. Learn more.

This revenue impacts how and where offers appear (including, the order in which they appear), except where prohibited by law for offers related to mortgage, home equity and other home lending products.
